title: Open Values Synonym Index v0.1
description: A lookup from everyday words people type, such as "oat milk", to the category or label on the site they mean. The data build writes it from content/synonyms.json, and Ask search reads it.

format.description: Names this file's format, so a reader can check it before reading the rest of the file.

version.description: The version of the format this file follows, such as "0.1".

built.description: The date of the source data this file was built from, as YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: The file the synonyms come from, content/synonyms.json.

aliases.description: A map from each everyday term, as written in content/synonyms.json, to the category or tag id it means, such as "oat milk" to "ovs:cat/plant-based-milk".

normalized.description: The same map, keyed by each term after normalization, for matching what people type.

targets.description: A map from each category or tag id to the terms that point at it.
